entries.text: Itching on arms and back at night. Applied calamine; nails kept short.
Slept well. Ate 2 idli with sambar and walked to the balcony with the walker.
Tired and nauseous after chemotherapy. Small frequent meals; managed rice kanji and curd.
Dull ache under the right ribs after lunch, 3 out of 10. Settled with rest.
Tingling in fingertips and toes since chemotherapy. Holding the cup carefully.
Reduced appetite, only tea and a few biscuits. Weight slowly coming down.
Tired after chemotherapy, slept most of the afternoon. Sugars higher today.
Small redness at the edge of the sacral pressure sore. Cleaned and re-dressed.
Fever with chills since last night. Eyes look yellow and itching is worse.
Fever persists, urine dark and stools pale. Called the oncology helpline; asked to come in for ERCP.
Back home after ERCP. Fever settled; weak and sleepy. Started ciprofloxacin.
Yellowness of the eyes reducing. Eating khichdi.
Constipation for two days. Increased water and papaya at lunch.
Slept late due to leg cramps. Massaged calves.

entries.outcome: CA 19-9 189 U/mL, up from 158. Continue chemotherapy; repeat markers each cycle and CT scan in about 6 weeks.

entries.title: ERCP (day care): biliary stent replaced
entries.outcome: Fever with jaundice (cholangitis). Blocked biliary stent replaced. Blood culture sent. Oral ciprofloxacin for 7 days (penicillin allergy noted).

entries.title: Diabetes review
entries.outcome: Sugars high around chemotherapy days. Insulin glargine increased from 12 to 14 units at bedtime. Continue Metformin.
